items.q: How is this different from meditation?
items.a: Meditation asks you to observe the mind. Breathwork uses the breath as a lever to shift the body's state directly — often producing results that years of meditation couldn't.

faqs.a: Instantly. The minute you check out, you'll get an email with login details. The first audio plays in your browser — no app to install.

faqs.q: Do I need to be flexible or fit?
faqs.a: No. You'll be lying down or sitting comfortably for every session.

faqs.q: What if I have anxiety or trauma?
faqs.a: Every audio is designed to be safe for self-led practice. We start with grounding before any activation. If you're under treatment for a serious condition, please consult your provider first.
Yes — one-time. No subscription, no upsell. The price is intentionally low because we want this to reach people who can't afford a 4,800€ facilitator training but still need this work.

faqs.q: What if it doesn't work for me?
faqs.a: Email refund@alchemyofbreath.com within 30 days and we'll refund every euro. No questions, no friction.
